# CommandMap Schema

Defines the YAML artifact produced by Phase 3 (Debate) and consumed by Phase 4 (Generate). Saved to `<project>/.claude/skill-data/CommandMap.yaml`.

## Schema

```yaml
# CommandMap.yaml — generated by CommandExtract
version: "1.0"

project:
  name: string                    # Project name
  path: string                    # Absolute path to project root
  language: string                # Primary language (Go, Python, TypeScript, etc.)
  framework: string | null        # Primary framework if any
  domain: string                  # Domain in 2-5 words

introspection:
  makefile_targets:               # Targets from Makefile / justfile / taskfile
    - name: string                # e.g. "test", "lint", "build"
      recipe: string              # The shell command(s) it runs
  cli_subcommands:                # Commands from the project's own CLI
    - command: string             # e.g. "hf portfolio list"
      description: string
  scripts:                        # Files in scripts/, bin/, or package.json scripts
    - path: string
      purpose: string
  ci_steps:                       # Steps from .github/workflows/, .gitlab-ci.yml, etc.
    - name: string
      command: string
  common_actions:                 # Repeatable developer actions observed in README, CONTRIBUTING, etc.
    - action: string              # Verb phrase: "run integration tests", "seed the database"
      current_invocation: string  # How it's done today: "make test-integration"
  existing_commands:              # Commands already created for this project (from Phase 1 scan)
    - name: string                # kebab-case command name (from filename)
      description: string         # From frontmatter description field
      argument_hint: string | null
      model: string | null        # haiku | sonnet | opus
      allowed_tools: string | null
      actions_covered:            # What actions this command handles (extracted from body)
        - string

scope: enum                       # project | global | both
  # project = .claude/commands/ (this repo only)
  # global = ~/.claude/commands/ (all repos)
  # both = some project-specific, some global

commands:
  - name: string                  # kebab-case command name (e.g. "test-unit")
    scope: enum                   # project | global
    description: string           # Under 60 chars, starts with verb (for frontmatter)
    argument_hint: string | null  # e.g. "[file] [--verbose]" or null if no args
    allowed_tools: string | null  # e.g. "Bash(go test:*), Read" or null for defaults
    model: enum | null            # haiku | sonnet | opus | null (inherit)
    body_summary: string          # 2-3 sentence description of what the prompt body does
    inline_context:               # !`command` calls to inject live context
      - command: string           # e.g. "git status", "go test ./... 2>&1 | tail -20"
        purpose: string           # Why this context is needed
    actions_covered:              # Which common_actions this command handles
      - string
    rationale: string             # Why this command exists (from debate)
    category: string | null       # Optional grouping: git, test, build, deploy, dev, ops

debate_summary:
  consolidator_count: number
  splitter_count: number
  final_count: number
  key_merges:                     # Commands the Consolidator successfully argued to merge
    - merged: string              # e.g. "test-unit + test-integration -> test [scope]"
      reason: string
  key_splits:                     # Commands the Splitter successfully argued to keep separate
    - split: string               # e.g. "build -> build-cli + build-tui"
      reason: string
  promotions:                     # Actions too complex for a command, promoted to skill
    - action: string
      reason: string
      suggested_skill: string
```

## Validation Rules

Enforced by the orchestrator during synthesis and verified before user approval:

| Rule | Constraint | Failure Action |
|------|-----------|----------------|
| **Skill promotion** | Multi-phase actions needing state, approval gates, or agent spawning are skills, not commands | Promote to skill; record in `debate_summary.promotions` |
| **Convergence signal** | Boundaries both agents agreed on in R3 are kept | No further synthesis needed |
| **Single responsibility** | Each command does one thing, invoked by one slash | Split multi-action commands |
| **Tool homogeneity** | All code paths in a command need the same `allowed-tools` and `model` | Split into separate commands |
| **Frequency gate** | Commands used < 1x/week are poor candidates | Demote to documentation or Makefile target |
| **Action coverage** | Every common action maps to at least one command | Uncovered = gap; flag for user |
| **Namespace hygiene** | Total count manageable in `/help` (aim 8-15); no conflicts with built-ins | Use subdirectory namespaces if > 15; rename conflicts |
| **Name uniqueness** | No two commands share the same name | Rename with qualifier (e.g. `test-unit`, `test-e2e`) |
| **Kebab-case names** | All command names are kebab-case | Auto-correct |
| **Description length** | Under 60 characters, starts with verb | Truncate or rephrase |
| **Argument complexity** | Commands with > 3 arguments should consider splitting | Split or use `$ARGUMENTS` for freeform |
| **Tool minimality** | `allowed-tools` is as restrictive as possible | Remove unnecessary tools |
| **Model economy** | Use `haiku` for simple tasks, `sonnet` for moderate, `opus` only when essential | Downgrade over-specified models |
| **No skill overlap** | Commands should not duplicate existing skill workflows | Remove or reference the skill instead |
| **Existing command dedup** | Proposed commands must not duplicate existing commands' actions | Drop duplicate; recommend extending existing command instead |

## Example (minimal)

```yaml
version: "1.0"

project:
  name: myproject
  path: /Users/me/Projects/myproject
  language: Go
  framework: Cobra
  domain: CLI data management tool

introspection:
  makefile_targets:
    - name: test
      recipe: go test -cover ./...
    - name: lint
      recipe: golangci-lint run
    - name: docs
      recipe: go run mkdocs/main.go
  cli_subcommands:
    - command: hf portfolio list
      description: List current positions
    - command: hf macro snapshot
      description: Current macro regime
  scripts:
    - path: scripts/build-logseq-toc.ts
      purpose: Rebuild LogSeq table of contents
  ci_steps: []
  common_actions:
    - action: run all tests with coverage
      current_invocation: make test
    - action: rebuild documentation
      current_invocation: make docs && make docs-validate

scope: project

commands:
  - name: test
    scope: project
    description: Run tests with coverage report
    argument_hint: "[package] [--integration]"
    allowed_tools: "Bash(go test:*), Bash(make test:*)"
    model: haiku
    body_summary: >
      Runs go test with coverage. If package arg given, tests only that package.
      With --integration, includes integration build tag.
    inline_context:
      - command: "go test ./... -count=1 2>&1 | tail -30"
        purpose: Show current test state before acting
    actions_covered:
      - run all tests with coverage
    rationale: "Most frequent developer action — run 20x/day during active development"
    category: test

  - name: docs
    scope: project
    description: Regenerate and validate all documentation
    argument_hint: null
    allowed_tools: "Bash(make docs:*), Bash(make docs-validate:*)"
    model: haiku
    body_summary: >
      Runs make docs then make docs-validate. Reports any unresolved placeholders.
    inline_context:
      - command: "make docs-validate 2>&1"
        purpose: Show current validation state
    actions_covered:
      - rebuild documentation
    rationale: "Documentation pipeline is a single repeatable action with binary pass/fail"
    category: build

debate_summary:
  consolidator_count: 6
  splitter_count: 20
  final_count: 12
  key_merges:
    - merged: "test-unit + test-cover -> test [--cover]"
      reason: "Same underlying command, just a flag difference"
  key_splits:
    - split: "build -> build-cli + build-tui + build-desk"
      reason: "Different binaries with different build flags and use patterns"
  promotions:
    - action: "full deployment pipeline with rollback"
      reason: "Multi-phase, needs state tracking and approval gates"
      suggested_skill: "Deployment"
```
